getApp.body.en:
Reporting waits and problems is only available in the PickupRadar mobile app.

The preview on this website is read-only.
getApp.body.text:
Ka warbixinta sugitaanka iyo dhibaatooyinka waxaa lagu sameyn karaa oo keliya app-ka mobilka ee PickupRadar.

Muuqaalka horudhaca ah ee boggan waa daawasho oo keliya.

getApp.cityAlert.en:
Get a launch alert when {city} goes live.

Launch alerts are set up in the mobile app.
getApp.cityAlert.text:
Hel ogeysiis marka {city} la bilaabo.

Ogeysiisyada bilowga waxaa lagu dejiyaa app-ka mobilka.

getApp.cityRequest.en:
Ask for PickupRadar in your city.

City requests are sent from the mobile app.
getApp.cityRequest.text:
Codso PickupRadar magaaladaada.

Codsiyada magaalooyinka waxaa laga diraa app-ka mobilka.

saved.appOnly.text: Keydinta meelaha qaadista waxaa laga heli karaa app-ka mobilka.
